user.title: Device Inventory
user.description: Adds classified device tables (Shelly, ESPHome, ZigBee, ...) with photos, notes and print support. Nothing to configure.

init.title: AI for manuals and product photos
init.description: Optional. Choose the AI task entity of an AI provider set up in Home Assistant (for example Google Generative AI, OpenAI or Anthropic). Device Inventory then asks it for the manuals and product photos of your devices. Only the manufacturer and the model are sent; every address is checked before it is saved. Leave empty to turn it off. For network devices without a model the device name is sent instead.

data.ai_copy_local: Archive found PDFs in Home Assistant (recommended)
data.ai_images: Also store a product photo found by the AI

data_description.ai_copy_local: Stores every PDF manual the AI finds on your Home Assistant (config/device_inventory/manuals). The archive keeps the state of the manual of today, works without internet and keeps the manuals of old devices even if they disappear from the website of the manufacturer.
data_description.ai_images: For devices without any photo, the AI also looks for an original product photo on the own website of the manufacturer (never shops or image sites); it is stored on your Home Assistant like your own photos. Please use it only for your own documentation.
